description: This Java source file defines the HashMapObserver class, which implements the HashMapObserverMBean interface. It provides methods for monitoring and retrieving information about sessions stored in a map, including counts of gateways, active/non-active sessions, and session details. It is part of the MQTT transport layer in the Thingsboard server project.

classes.name: HashMapObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and reports on session data stored in a map, providing various session statistics and details.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of sessions in the map.

methods.name: getGatewayCount
methods.description: Counts the number of sessions that are gateways.

methods.name: getNonGatewayCount
methods.description: Counts the number of sessions that are not gateways.

methods.name: addContent
methods.description: Helper method to add session content to a StringBuilder, replacing line separators.

methods.name: getAllSessions
methods.description: Returns a string listing all sessions.

methods.name: getSubscribedSessions
methods.description: Returns a string listing all sessions with subscriptions to RPC or attributes.

methods.name: getNonActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns a string listing all non-active sessions.

methods.name: getActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns a string listing all active sessions.

methods.name: getGatewayDeviceSessionContextConnectedSessions
methods.description: Returns sessions where GatewayDeviceSessionContext is connected.

methods.name: getDeviceAwareSessionContextNotConnectedSessions
methods.description: Returns sessions where DeviceAwareSessionContext is not connected.
